pairs.title: Metronidazole and warfarin
pairs.text: Metronidazole can increase the effect of warfarin and raise the risk of bleeding. Ask your prescriber or pharmacist to review these medicines together.

source.name: NAFDAC Greenbook · Metronidazole product information, section 4.5

pairs.title: Metronidazole and lithium
pairs.text: Metronidazole can slow the removal of lithium from the body. Ask your prescriber or pharmacist to review these medicines together.

source.name: NAFDAC Greenbook · Metronidazole product information, section 4.5

pairs.title: Clarithromycin and simvastatin
pairs.text: The product information warns that using these together can cause serious muscle injury. Ask your prescriber or pharmacist to review the combination promptly.

source.name: NAFDAC Greenbook · Clarithromycin product information, section 4.5

pairs.title: Co-trimoxazole and warfarin
pairs.text: Co-trimoxazole can increase the effect of warfarin. Ask your prescriber or pharmacist to review these medicines together.
